benchmark_train: run a benchmark to measure Detectron2 model training speed over 400 iterations with profiling
benchmark_eval: run a benchmark to measure Detectron2 model inference speed over 300 iterations on a single GPU
benchmark_data: run a benchmark to measure Detectron2 data loader throughput and RAM usage across distributed workers
benchmark_data_advanced: run an advanced benchmark to analyze dataloader performance bottlenecks including dataset, mapper, workers, and IPC
setup: load and configure a Detectron2 config from a YAML or Python file with optional overrides
